name: 'A Moving Line’: Evolving Identities in Comics and Graphic Narratives
description: Join us for the book discussion of A Moving Line, a celebration of India’s rich history of visual storytelling. Comic creator and visual artists Rahil Mohsin and Mia Jose will be in conversation with designer Kriti Monga to reflect on how storytelling in graphic narratives has evolved over centuries and the many nuances and developments in it.

name: Messy, Crazy, Real: A dialogue on mental health and disability
description:
Join Srinidhi Raghavan, and Esther Larisa David, for a fireside chat exploring mental health and disability representation through art and literature. Unpacking Esther’s comic Oversaturated and followed by a reading of Srinidhi’s essay Am I really disabled?, both from Insights, the conversation examines how lived experiences challenge stereotypes and reshape narratives around disability, mental health and well-being.

This event is in collaboration with Rising Flame.

name: Make at MAP
description: Zodiac signs have long been used to make sense of human nature and personalities. If there are universal traits, then where do we stand as individuals? Drawing inspiration from Arpita Singh's Zodiac series, create a personal zodiac inspired artwork using symbols and everyday references to express your traits, question familiar stereotypes or reflect.
